changelog: BREAKING: config.lua fully reorganized (Config.Companies) and oxmysql is now required - fresh install recommended, do not paste the old customize/ back. Company desk: desk NPC dialog (camera + typing effect) handles duty toggle, company management, and route management; multi-company + ExtraDesks supported. Boss management MDT panel: company funds, commission, hire/fire incl. offline staff, grades, employee stats. Route management in a map editor panel (create/edit/delete/toggle, DB-backed). Onboard bus terminal replaces the F7 dashboard (U = toggle, Q = mouse focus, ESC = release): live bus status, stats/leaderboard (INFO), daily challenges (ANNC), route selection on a satellite map (ROUTE), payment + route result screens. Depot dispatch dialog with bus cards (interface/vehicleimage/<model>.webp), seat counts, level locks, multiple spawn bays, optional rental fee (Depot.RentalFee). Group fares with party-mix entry on the terminal, declined-card decision (free ride or deny), settlement payout to bank on route completion with company commission. nc-vehiclekeys support (other key systems still work as fallback).
